name: Trofana
beschreibung: The holiday apartment Trofana enjoys a peaceful location in Sölden, just a short walk from the village centre. The accommodation features classic alpine decor with warm wooden furnishings and a cosy living area. Guests benefit from a fully equipped self-catering kitchen, as well as access to a ski cellar and a dedicated storage room for sports gear. The Ötztal valley provides an exhilarating backdrop for scenic hikes and premier skiing adventures.
